notes.title: Soul Reaper DLC
notes.notes:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2138370/No_King_No_Kingdom__Soul_Reaper/

A legendary artifact from the Era of Chaos. Its creator Drein had a frail body and was the weakest of his kind. His deepest desire was to be accepted. So, Drein searched for ways to gain power whitch would make him equal with others. One of the results of that searches was a Soul Reaper. Scythe, which can absorb the might of fallen enemies.

Soul Reaper is a new item for No King No Kingdom. The artifact will be automatically added to your inventory.

Soul Reaper has several abilities:
[list]
[*] The scythe deals melee damage and absorbs soul when killing the target. The amount of power absorbed depends on the target's power.
[*] Damage increases depending on how many souls the scythe has collected.
[*] The scythe Summons minions when used on resources. The more power Soul Reaper has absorbed, the more minions it summons.
[*] When Scythe gathers enough strength and is used on a golden tree it may conjure an uncontrollable anomaly boss fight.
[/list]

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31134781/bd02bea29cbfce2fb99a87d9f1dcf5ba00c3ac6d.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31134781/a2e4f893027ecdbb46715fe58f749473912c539e.png[/img]
Now you can better control the behavior of your troops with Stances:

Don't attack - troops will not attack without orders (convenient if you want your riding dragon not to go into battle)

Stand ground - troops will stand and will not attack until the enemy enters the attack range

Defend - troops will start attacking when the enemy is a few steps away

Combat - default mode, troops will attack the enemy who is in the middle distance

Aggressive - troops  will attack the enemy even if the target is far away

Priority King's orders:  king orders have higher priority than AI auto aggro now, so units will escape combat after your order

notes.title: Support Ukraine DLC: Shield of Great Protectors
notes.notes:
This DLC adds a new artifact to the game: "Shield of Great Protectors"

Lore: This artifact appeared when the Red Horde insidiously attacked the young Kingdom. The orcs thought that the human race would not withstand even a couple of days against their power. However, unity and desire to protect their home empower people to stop anything and everyone

Effect: The target loses the ability to attack for a short time
